method.secondary_oracle: GitHub content API blob ID compared with manifest blob and separately fetched complete, nontruncated Git-tree inventory
method.frozen_python_evaluator: frozen_pr124_content_binding_evaluator_v1_20261024.py inspected at commit 123d13f5617dd969faad00a21a8dc6437a31d82d; actual Python evaluator NOT_EXECUTED
method.hash_semantics: SHA-256 independently computed from decoded bytes; Git blob SHA-1 values compared across GitHub API views, not independently recomputed in this run

negative_fixtures: Historical wrong tree field is detected and corrected only append-only
falsifier: Any of the 54 original files at immutable head e0b5d8e... produces a different raw byte count or SHA-256 from the pinned manifest; or the pinned Git-commit tree differs from the append-only correction; or a negative fixture is incorrectly accepted.
